integrity: Original finite-field derivation and standalone exact-code diagnostics; finite tests corroborate rather than prove the all-size statement. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary phase spaces over the two-element field, power-of-two site counts, and symmetric binary circulant couplings only. The full real-valued dynamical system and odd site counts are not covered. Earlier general coupled cat-map recurrence results are credited; unindexed literature might contain an equivalent valuation criterion.
title: Augmentation-valuation universality for binary circulant cat-map orbit spectra
